payloads.title: Profile Removal Password
payloads.description: The payload that configures profile removal.

keys.title: Removal Password
keys.content: The password to allow removing the profile.

payloads.title: Relay
payloads.description: The payload that configures relay settings.

keys.title: Relays
keys.content: An array of dictionaries that describe one or more relay servers that the system can chain together.

subkeys.title: HTTP/3 Relay URL
subkeys.content:
The URL or URI template, as defined in RFC 9298, of a relay server that's reachable using HTTP/3 and supports proxying TCP and UDP using the CONNECT method.

Each relay needs to include either `HTTP2RelayURL` or `HTTP3RelayURL`, or it can include both.

subkeys.title: HTTP/2 Relay URL
subkeys.content:
The URL or URI template, as defined in RFC 9298, of a relay server that's reachable using HTTP/2 and supports proxying TCP and UDP using the CONNECT method.

Each relay needs to include either `HTTP2RelayURL` or `HTTP3RelayURL`, or it can include both.

subkeys.title: Additional HTTP Header Fields
subkeys.content: A dictionary that contains custom HTTP header keys and values to add to each request. The dictionary key name represents the HTTP header field name to use, and the dictionary value is the string to use as the HTTP header field value.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: The HTTP header field value for the corresponding header field name.

subkeys.title: Certificate UUID
subkeys.content: The UUID that points to an identity certificate payload, which the system uses to authenticate the user to the relay server.

subkeys.title: Raw Public Keys
subkeys.content:
An array of DER-encoded raw public keys that the system uses to authenticate the server during a TLS handshake. The server needs to use one of the keys in the handshake to authenticate.

If this array is empty, the system uses the default TLS trust evaluation.

keys.title: Match Domains
keys.content:
A list of domain strings that the system uses to determine which connection to route through the servers in `Relays`.

Any connection that matches a domain in the list exactly or is a subdomain of the listed domain uses the relay servers, unless it matches a domain in `ExcludedDomains`.

If this list and `MatchFQDNs` are empty, the system routes traffic to all domains to the relay servers, except those that match an excluded domain or excluded FQDN.

keys.title: Excluded Domains
keys.content: A list of domain strings to exclude from routing through the servers in `Relays`. Any connection that matches a domain in the list exactly or is a subdomain of the listed domain won't use the relay server.

keys.title: Match FQDNs
keys.content: A list of Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDNs) to be routed through the servers contained in `Relays`. Any connection that matches an FQDN in the list exactly uses the relay servers. If this list and `MatchDomains` are empty, the system routes traffic to all domains to the relay servers, except those that match an excluded domain or excluded FQDN.

keys.title: Excluded FQDNs
keys.content: A list of Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDNs) to exclude from routing through the servers contained in `Relays`. Any connection that matches an FQDN in the list exactly won't use the relay server. When `MatchDomains` is also present, any FQDN listed in the list should be a subdomain of at least one `MatchDomain` value, otherwise it will not have any effect.

keys.title: RelayUUID
keys.content: A globally unique identifier for this relay configuration. The system uses this UUID to route managed apps through the servers in `Relays`. This key is required for user enrollment.

keys.title: UI Toggle Enabled
keys.content: If `true`, the device allows the user to disable this network relay configuration.

keys.title: Allow DNS Failover
keys.content: If `true`, the device allows the relay to failover to the default system DNS resolver.

payloads.title: Restrictions
payloads.description: The payload that configures restrictions on a device.

keys.title: allowAccountModification
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables modification of accounts, such as Apple Accounts, and internet-based accounts, such as Mail, Contacts, and Calendar.

keys.title: Allow Handoff
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables activity continuation. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated. In a future release, this restriction will begin requiring supervision and will apply to personal Apple Accounts only.

keys.title: Allow Adding Game Center Friends
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits adding friends to Game Center. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

keys.title: allowAirDrop
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables AirDrop.

keys.title: Allow incoming AirPlay requests
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables incoming AirPlay requests.

keys.title: Allow AirPrint
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables AirPrint.

keys.title: Allow storage of AirPrint credentials in Keychain
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Keychain storage of user name and password for AirPrint.

keys.title: Allow discovery of AirPrint printers using iBeacons
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iBeacon discovery of AirPrint printers, which prevents spurious AirPrint Bluetooth beacons from phishing for network traffic.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Cellular Data Usage for Apps Settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables changing settings for cellular data usage for apps.

keys.title: Allow App Clips
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents a user from adding any App Clips, and removes any existing App Clips on the device.

keys.title: Allow App Installation
keys.content:
If `false`, the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users are unable to install or update their apps. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

In iOS 10 and later, MDM commands can override this restriction. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

keys.title: Allow Apple Intelligence Report
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Apple Intelligence reports.

keys.title: allowApplePersonalizedAdvertising
keys.content: If `false`, the system limits Apple personalized advertising.

keys.title: Allow App Removal
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables removal of apps from an iOS device. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

keys.title: Allow Hiding Apps
keys.content: If `false`, disables the ability for the user to hide apps. It doesn't affect the user's ability to leave it in the App Library, while removing it from the Home Screen.

keys.title: Allow Locking Apps
keys.content: If `false`, disables the ability for the user to lock apps. Because hiding apps also requires locking them, disallowing locking also disallows hiding.

keys.title: Allow modifying Remote Management Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying the Remote Management Sharing setting in System Settings.

keys.title: Allow Siri
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Siri.

keys.title: allowAssistantUserGeneratedContent
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents Siri from querying user-generated content from the web.

keys.title: Allow Siri While Locked
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Siri when the device is locked. The system ignores this restriction if the device doesn't have a passcode set.

keys.title: Allow Auto Correction
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables keyboard autocorrection.

keys.title: Allow Auto Dim
keys.content: If `false`, disables auto dim on iPads with OLED displays.

keys.title: Allow Automatic App Downloads
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents automatic downloading of apps purchased on other devices. This setting doesn't affect updates to existing apps.

keys.title: allowAutomaticScreenSaver
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Apple TV's automatic screen saver.

keys.title: allowAutoUnlock
keys.content: If `false`, the system disallows auto unlock. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow modifying Bluetooth settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Bluetooth settings.

keys.title: Allow modifying Bluetooth Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Bluetooth settings in System Settings.

keys.title: Allow Bookstore
keys.content: If `false`, the system removes the Book Store tab from the Books app.

keys.title: Allow Bookstore Erotica
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents the user from downloading Apple Books media that's tagged as erotica. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow Call Recording
keys.content: If `false`, disables call recording.

keys.title: Allow Camera Use
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the camera and removes its icon from the Home Screen, and users are unable to take photographs. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCellularPlanModification
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents users from changing settings related to their cellular plan (available only on select carriers).

keys.title: Allow use of iMessage
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the use of iMessage with supervised devices. If the device supports text messaging, the user can still send and receive text messages.

keys.title: allowCloudAddressBook
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Contacts services.

keys.title: Allow iCloud Backup
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables backing up the device to iCloud. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCloudBookmarks
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Bookmark sync.

keys.title: allowCloudCalendar
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Calendar services.

keys.title: allowCloudDesktopAndDocuments
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Desktop and Document services.

keys.title: Allow iCloud Document Sync
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables document and key-value syncing to iCloud. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later, and Shared iPad doesn't support it. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCloudFreeform
keys.content: If `false`, the system disallows iCloud Freeform services.

keys.title: allowCloudKeychainSync
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Keychain synchronization. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCloudMail
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Mail services.

keys.title: allowCloudNotes
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Notes services.

keys.title: Allow iCloud Photo Library
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Photo Library. The system removes any photos from local storage that aren't fully downloaded from iCloud Photo Library to the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCloudPrivateRelay
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Private Relay. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

keys.title: allowCloudReminders
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iCloud Reminder services.

keys.title: allowContentCaching
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables content caching. This restriction is not supported on the user channel.

keys.title: Allow Continuous Path Keyboard
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables QuickPath keyboard.

keys.title: Allow default browser modification
keys.content: If `false`, disables default browser preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default browser preference still works when applying this.

keys.title: Allow default calling app modification
keys.content: If `false`, disables default calling app preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default calling app preference still works when applying this.

keys.title: Allow default messaging app modification
keys.content: If `false`, disables default messaging app preference modification. The MDM Settings command to set the default messaging app preference still works when applying this.

keys.title: Allow Define
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables definition lookup.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Device Name
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents the user from changing the device name.

keys.title: Allow Device Sleep
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents the device from automatically sleeping.

keys.title: Allow diagnostic submission
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents the device from automatically submitting diagnostic reports to Apple.

keys.title: Allow modifying diagnostics settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables changing the diagnostic submission and app analytics settings in the Diagnostics & Usage UI in Settings.

keys.title: Allow dictation
keys.content: If `false`, the system disallows dictation input.

keys.title: Allowed Exceptions to Camera Restriction
keys.content: If present, the system exempts apps with bundle IDs in the array from the `allowCamera` restriction. The system doesn't grant these apps access to the camera automatically; they're only exempted from the `allowCamera` restriction. This key has no effect when the camera isn't restricted. Multiple payloads combine using an intersect operation. Requires a supervised device.

keys.title: Allowed External Intelligence Workspace IDs
keys.content: An array of strings, but currently restricted to a single element. If present, Apple Intelligence allows use of only the given external integration workspace ID, and requires a sign-in to make requests. The user is required to sign in to integrations that support signing in. Multiple payloads combine using an intersect operation. This means the allowed set of workspace IDs can become the empty set if multiple payloads specify conflicting values.

keys.title: Allow Configuring Restrictions or ScreenTime
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Enable Restrictions option in the Restrictions UI in Settings. If `false` in iOS 12 and later, the system disables the Enable ScreenTime option in the ScreenTime UI in Settings and disables ScreenTime if already enabled.

keys.title: Allow Trusting Enterprise Apps
keys.content: If `false`, the system removes the Trust Enterprise Developer button in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, which prevents provisioning apps by universal provisioning profiles. This restriction applies to free developer accounts and enterprise app developers that aren't implicitly trusted by apps that install through MDM. This restriction doesn't revoke previously granted trust.

keys.title: Allow Enterprise Books Backup
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables backup of Enterprise books.

keys.title: Allow Enterprise Books Notes and Highlights Sync
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables sync of Enterprise books, notes, and highlights.

keys.title: Allow Erase All Content and Settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Erase All Content and Settings option in the Reset UI.

keys.title: Allow eSIM Modification
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables modifications of eSIMs.

keys.title: Allow eSIM Outgoing Transfers
keys.content: If `false`, prevents the transfer of an eSIM from the device on which the restriction is installed to a different device.

keys.title: Allow Explicit Content
keys.content:
If `false`, the system hides explicit music or video content purchased from the iTunes Store. The system marks explicit content as such by content providers, such as record labels, when sold through the iTunes Store. Explicit content in the News and Podcast apps is also hidden.

Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow external intelligence integrations
keys.content: If `false`, disables the use of external, cloud-based intelligence services with Siri. In iOS, this restriction is temporarily allowed on unsupervised and user enrollments. In a future release, this restriction will require supervision, and will be ignored on unsupervised devices.

keys.title: Allow external intelligence integrations sign-in
keys.content: If `false`, forces external intelligence providers into anonymous mode. If a user is already signed in to an external intelligence provider, applying this restriction signs them out when attempting the next request.

keys.title: Allow modifying File Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying File Sharing setting in System Settings.

keys.title: allowFilesNetworkDriveAccess
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents connecting to network drives in the Files app.

keys.title: allowFilesUSBDriveAccess
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents connecting to any connected USB devices in the Files app.

keys.title: allowFindMyDevice
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Find My Device in the Find My app.

keys.title: allowFindMyFriends
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Find My Friends in the Find My app.

keys.title: allowFindMyFriendsModification
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables changes to Find My Friends.

keys.title: Allow Touch ID to Unlock Device
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents Touch ID, Face ID, or Optic ID from unlocking a device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Touch ID Fingerprints
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents the user from modifying Touch ID or Face ID.

keys.title: Allow Game Center
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Game Center, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen.

keys.title: Allow Genmoji
keys.content: If `false`, prohibits creating new Genmoji.

keys.title: Allow Automatic Sync While Roaming
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables global background fetch activity when an iOS phone is roaming. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: allowHostPairing
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables host pairing with the exception of the supervision host. If there's no configured supervision host certificate, the system disables all pairing. Host pairing lets the administrator control whether an iOS device can pair with a host Mac or PC.

keys.title: Allow Image Playground
keys.content: If `false`, prohibits the use of image generation.

keys.title: Allow Image Wand
keys.content: If `false`, prohibits the use of Image Wand.

keys.title: Allow In App Purchases
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits in-app purchasing. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow modifying Internet Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying the Internet Sharing setting in System Settings.

keys.title: Allow iPhone mirroring
keys.content: If `false`, prohibits the use of iPhone Mirroring. In macOS, this prevents the Mac from mirroring any iPhone. In iOS, this prevents the iPhone from mirroring to any Mac.

keys.title: Allow iPhone widget on Mac
keys.content: If `false`, the system disallows iPhone widgets on a Mac that signs in with the same Apple Account for iCloud.

keys.title: Allow use of iTunes
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the iTunes Music Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users can't preview, purchase, or download content. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

keys.title: allowiTunesFileSharing
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables iTunes file sharing services.

keys.title: Allow Keyboard Shortcuts
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables keyboard shortcuts.

keys.title: Allow Listed Apps
keys.content: If present, the system only shows or can launch apps with bundle IDs in the array. Include the value `com.apple.webapp` to allow all webclips. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

keys.title: Allow Live Voicemail
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables live voicemail on the device.

keys.title: Allow creating users in System Settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents creating users in System Settings.

keys.title: allowLockScreenControlCenter
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents Control Center from appearing on the Lock Screen.

keys.title: allowLockScreenNotificationsView
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Notifications history view on the Lock Screen, so users can't view past notifications. However, they can still see notifications when they arrive.

keys.title: allowLockScreenTodayView
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Today view in Notification Center on the Lock Screen.

keys.title: allowMailPrivacyProtection
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Mail Privacy Protection on the device.

keys.title: allowMailSmartReplies
keys.content: If `false`, disables smart replies in Mail.

keys.title: allowMailSummary
keys.content: If `false`, disables the ability to create summaries of email messages manually. This doesn't affect automatic summary generation.

keys.title: Allow iCloud Sync for Managed Apps
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents managed apps from using iCloud sync.

keys.title: Allow managed apps to write to managed contacts accounts
keys.content:
If `true`, the system allows managed apps to write contacts to unmanaged accounts. If `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` is `true`, this restriction has no effect.

> Important:
> Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

keys.title: Allow App Installation from alternative marketplaces
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents installation of alternative marketplace apps from the web and prevents any installed alternative marketplace apps from installing apps.

keys.title: Allow modifying Media Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, prevents modification of Media Sharing settings.

keys.title: Allow Multiplayer Gaming
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits multiplayer gaming.

keys.title: Allow Apple Music
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Music service, and the Music app reverts to classic mode.

keys.title: Allow use of News
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables News.

keys.title: allowNFC
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables NFC.

keys.title: allowNotesTranscription
keys.content: If `false`, disables transcription in Notes.

keys.title: allowNotesTranscriptionSummary
keys.content: If `false`, disables transcription summarization in Notes.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Notifications Settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables modification of notification settings.

keys.title: Enable allow open from managed to unmanaged
keys.content: If `false`, documents in managed apps and accounts open only in other managed apps and accounts.

keys.title: Enable allow open from unmanaged to managed
keys.content: If `false`, documents in unmanaged apps and accounts open only in other unmanaged apps and accounts.

keys.title: allowOTAPKIUpdates
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables over-the-air PKI updates. Setting this restriction to `false` doesn't disable CRL and OCSP checks.

keys.title: Allow Pairing With Apple Watch
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables pairing with an Apple Watch, and the system unpairs any currently paired Apple Watch and erases its content.

keys.title: Allow Wallet While Locked
keys.content: If `false`, the system hides Passbook notifications from the Lock Screen.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Passcode
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents adding, changing, or removing the passcode. The system ignores this restriction on Shared iPad.

keys.title: allowPasswordAutoFill
keys.content:
If `false`, the system disables:

- The AutoFill Passwords feature in iOS, with Keychain and third-party password managers
- Prompting the user to use a saved password in Safari or in apps
- Automatic strong passwords
- Suggesting strong passwords to users

However, if `false`, the system doesn't prevent AutoFill for contact info and credit cards in Safari.

keys.title: allowPasswordProximityRequests
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables requesting passwords from nearby devices.

keys.title: allowPasswordSharing
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables sharing passwords with the AirDrop passwords feature, or with the Passwords app.

keys.title: Allow modifying Personal Hotspot settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables modifications of the personal hotspot setting.

keys.title: Allow personalized handwriting results
keys.content: If false, prevents the system from generating text in the user's handwriting.

keys.title: Allow Photo Stream
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Photo Stream.

keys.title: allowPodcasts
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables podcasts.

keys.title: Allow Predictive Keyboard
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables predictive keyboards.

keys.title: Allow modifying Printer Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Printer Sharing settings in System Settings.

keys.title: allowProximitySetupToNewDevice
keys.content: If `false`, disables the prompt to set up new devices that are nearby. Starting with iOS 26.3, this also prevents exporting iOS data to set up new Android devices.

keys.title: Allow iTunes Radio
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Apple Music Radio.

keys.title: Allow Background Security Improvement Installation
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits installation of Background Security Improvements.

keys.title: Allow Background Security Improvement Removal
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits removal of Background Security Improvements.

keys.title: allowRCSMessaging
keys.content: If `false`, prevents the use of RCS messaging.

keys.title: Allow modifying Remote Apple Events Sharing setting
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modifying Remote Apple Events Sharing settings in System Settings.

keys.title: Allow pairing with Remote app
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables pairing Apple TV for use with the Control Center widget.

keys.title: Allow Remote Screen Observation
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables remote screen observation by the Classroom app. Nest this key beneath `allowScreenShot` as a subrestriction. If `allowScreenShot` is `false`, the Classroom app doesn't observe remote screens. Requires a supervised device until iOS 13 and macOS 10.15. Allowed for user enrollments in macOS 12 and later.

keys.title: allowRosettaUsageAwareness
keys.content: If `false`, disables Rosetta usage awareness. When Rosetta usage awareness is active, a pop-up dialog is displayed to the user when an app that is using Rosetta is launched. The pop-up dialog indicates that Rosetta will be removed in a future version of the operating system so that the user can contact the app vendor regarding a replacement for the current app.

keys.title: Allow use of Safari
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the Safari web browser app, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen. This setting also prevents users from opening web clips. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

keys.title: allowSafariHistoryClearing
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the ability to clear browsing history in Safari.

keys.title: allowSafariPrivateBrowsing
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the ability to use private browsing in Safari.

keys.title: allowSafariSummary
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the ability to summarize content in Safari.

keys.title: Allow use of satellite connectivity
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits the connection to and use of satellite services.

keys.title: Allow Screenshots and Screen Recording
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables saving a screenshot of the display and capturing a screen recording. It also disables the Classroom app from observing remote screens.

keys.title: allowSharedDeviceTemporarySession
keys.content: If `false`, the system makes temporary sessions unavailable on Shared iPad.

keys.title: Allow Shared Stream
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Shared Photo Stream. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow Spell Check
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the keyboard spell checker.

keys.title: Allow Siri Suggestions
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Spotlight Internet search results in Siri Suggestions. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Allow modifying Startup Disk settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Startup Disk settings in System Settings.

keys.title: allowSystemAppRemoval
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables the removal of system apps from the device.

keys.title: Allow modifying Time Machine settings
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents modification of Time Machine settings in System Settings. This restriction is not supported on the user channel.

keys.title: Allow App Installation from App Store
keys.content:
If `false`, the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. However, users can continue to install or update their apps either locally (via Configurator, Xcode, and so forth), or using alternative marketplace apps.

In iOS 10 and later, MDM commands can override this restriction.

keys.title: Allow UI Configuration Profile Installation
keys.content: If `false`, the system prohibits the user from installing configuration profiles and certificates interactively.

keys.title: Allow Universal Control
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables Universal Control.

keys.title: Allow unmanaged apps to read managed contacts accounts
keys.content:
If `true`, the system allows unmanaged apps to read from managed contacts accounts. If `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` is `true`, this restriction has no effect.

> Important:
> Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

keys.title: allowUnpairedExternalBootToRecovery
keys.content: If `true`, the system allows unpaired devices to boot devices into recovery.

keys.title: Allow user to accept untrusted TLS certificates
keys.content: If `false`, the system automatically rejects untrusted HTTPS certificates without prompting the user.

keys.title: allowUSBRestrictedMode
keys.content: If `false`, the system allows iOS devices to always connect to USB accessories while locked. In macOS, allows new USB and Thunderbolt accessories, and SD cards to connect without authorization. If the system has Lockdown mode enabled, it ignores this value. This restriction is not supported on the user channel.

keys.title: Allow Video Conferencing
keys.content: If `false`, the system hides the FaceTime app. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

keys.title: Allow Video Conferencing Remote Control
keys.content: If `false`, disables the ability for a remote FaceTime session to request control of the device.

keys.title: Allow Visual Intelligence Summary
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables visual intelligence summarization.

keys.title: Allow Voice Dialing While Device is Locked
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables voice dialing if the device is locked with a passcode.

keys.title: Allow Adding VPN Configurations (Supervised devices only)
keys.content: If `false`, the system allows only managed apps to create VPN configurations. Prior to iOS 18, the system also allows unmanaged apps to create VPN configurations.

keys.title: Allow Modifying Wallpaper
keys.content: If `false`, the system prevents changing the wallpaper.

keys.title: Allow App Installation from web sites
keys.content: If `false`, the device prevents installation of apps directly from the web.

keys.title: Allow writing tools
keys.content: If `false`, disables Apple Intelligence writing tools.

keys.title: autonomousSingleAppModePermittedAppIDs
keys.content: If present, the system allows apps identified by the bundle IDs listed in the array to autonomously enter Single App Mode.

subkeys.title: Apps allow list for Autonomous Single App Mode

keys.title: Blacklisted Apps
keys.content: Use `blockedAppBundleIDs` instead.

keys.title: Blocked Apps
keys.content:
If present, the system prevents showing or launching apps with bundle IDs in the array. Include the value `com.apple.webapp` to restrict all webclips. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

> Note:
> Denying system apps may disable other functionality. For example, denying the App Store app may prevent users from accepting the terms and conditions for the user-based Volume Purchase Program (VPP).

keys.title: deniedICCIDsForiMessageFaceTime
keys.content: An array of strings representing ICCIDs of cellular plans. The device prevents use of any matching cellular networks in iMessage and FaceTime. The array must contain no more than 4 ICCID strings.

subkeys.title: Denied ICCID for iMessage and FaceTime
subkeys.content: An ICCID.

keys.title: deniedICCIDsForRCS
keys.content: An array of strings representing ICCIDs of cellular plans. The device prevents use of any matching cellular networks with RCS messaging. The array must contain no more than 4 ICCID strings.

subkeys.title: Denied ICCID for RCS
subkeys.content: An ICCID.

keys.title: enforcedFingerprintTimeout
keys.content: The value, in seconds, after which the fingerprint unlock requires a password to authenticate. The default value is 48 hours.

keys.title: enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay
keys.content: How many days to delay a software update on the device. With this restriction in place, the user doesn't see a software update until the specified number of days after the software update release date. The restrictions `forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates` and `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates` use this value.

keys.title: enforcedSoftwareUpdateMajorOSDeferredInstallDelay
keys.content: This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay a major software upgrade on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a software upgrade only after the specified delay after the release of the software upgrade. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedMajorSoftwareUpdates`.

keys.title: enforcedSoftwareUpdateMinorOSDeferredInstallDelay
keys.content: This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay a minor OS software update on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a software update only after the specified delay after the release of the software update. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates`.

keys.title: enforcedSoftwareUpdateNonOSDeferredInstallDelay
keys.content: This restriction allows the administrator to set the number of days to delay an app software update on the device. When this restriction is in place, the user sees a non-OS software update only after the specified delay after the release of the software. This value controls the delay for `forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates`.

keys.title: Treat AirDrop as Unmanaged Destination
keys.content: If `true`, the system considers AirDrop to be an unmanaged drop target.

keys.title: forceAirPlayIncomingRequestsPairingPassword
keys.content: If `true`, the system forces all devices sending AirPlay requests to this device to use a pairing password. This key isn't supported in tvOS 10.2 and later. Use the AirPlay Security Payload instead.

keys.title: forceAirPlayOutgoingRequestsPairingPassword
keys.content: If `true`, the system forces all devices receiving AirPlay requests from this device to use a pairing password.

keys.title: Disallow AirPrint to destinations with untrusted certificates
keys.content: If `true`, the system requires trusted certificates for TLS printing communication.

keys.title: Enable Siri Profanity Filter
keys.content: If `true`, the system forces the use of the profanity filter for Siri and dictation. Requires a supervised device in iOS.

keys.title: forceAuthenticationBeforeAutoFill
keys.content: If `true`, the user needs to authenticate before the system can autofill passwords or credit card information in Safari and apps. If this restriction isn't enforced, the user can toggle this feature in Settings. Only supported on devices with Face ID or Touch ID.

keys.title: forceAutomaticDateAndTime
keys.content: If `true`, the system enables the Set Automatically feature in Date & Time and the user can't disable it. The system updates the device's time zone only when the device can determine its location using a cellular connection or Wi-Fi with location services enabled.

keys.title: forceBypassScreenCaptureAlert
keys.content: If `true`, then the system bypasses the presentation of a screen capture alert.

keys.title: forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses
keys.content: If `true`, the system automatically gives permission to the teacher's requests without prompting the student.

keys.title: forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveClasses
keys.content: If `true`, a student enrolled in an unmanaged course through Classroom needs to request permission from the teacher to leave the course.

keys.title: forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock
keys.content: If `true`, the system allows the teacher to lock apps or the device without prompting the student.

keys.title: forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservation
keys.content: If `true` and `ScreenObservationPermissionModificationAllowed` is also `true` in the Education payload, a student enrolled in a managed course through the Classroom app automatically gives permission to that course teacher's requests to observe the student's screen without prompting the student.

keys.title: forceDelayedAppSoftwareUpdates
keys.content: If `true`, the system delays user visibility of non-OS software updates. Control visibility of operating system updates through `forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates`. The delay is 30 days unless you set `enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay` to another value.

keys.title: forceDelayedMajorSoftwareUpdates
keys.content: If `true`, the system delays user visibility of major OS updates.

keys.title: forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates
keys.content: If `true`, the system delays user visibility of software updates. In macOS, the system allows seed build updates without delay. The delay is 30 days unless you set `enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay` to another value.

keys.title: Force Encrypted Backups
keys.content: If `true`, the system encrypts all backups.

keys.title: Require iTunes password for all purchases
keys.content: If `true`, the system forces the user to enter their iTunes password for each transaction.

keys.title: forceLimitAdTracking
keys.content: If `true`, the system limits ad tracking. Additionally, it disables app tracking and the Allow Apps to Request to Track setting.

keys.title: forceOnDeviceOnlyDictation
keys.content: If `true`, the system disables connections to Siri servers for the purposes of dictation.

keys.title: forceOnDeviceOnlyTranslation
keys.content: If `true`, the device can't connect to Siri servers for the purposes of translation.

keys.title: Force Preserve ESIM on Erase
keys.content:
If `true`, the system preserves eSIM when it erases the device due to too many failed password attempts or the Erase All Content and Settings option in Settings > General > Reset.

> Note:
> The system doesn't preserve eSIM if Find My initiates erasing the device.

keys.title: Force Apple Watch Wrist Detection
keys.content: If `true`, the system forces a paired Apple Watch to use Wrist Detection.

keys.title: Disallow Wi-Fi from being turned off
keys.content: If `true`, the system prevents turning off Wi-Fi in Settings or Control Center, even by entering or leaving Airplane Mode. It doesn't prevent selecting which Wi-Fi network to use. and later.

keys.title: forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly
keys.content: If `true`, the system limits the device to only join Wi-Fi networks set up through a configuration profile.

keys.title: Only join Wi-Fi networks installed by profiles
keys.content: Use `forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly` instead.

keys.title: Apps Ranking Number
keys.content:
The maximum level of app content allowed on the device. Starting with iOS 26.2, this rating may apply to certain system apps.

Age bands and the number of discrete age values vary by region, but the values are consistent across regions. For example, in a region that defines rating level 14+, its value is guaranteed to be larger than 300 (12+) and smaller than 600 (17+). Also, the value of rating level 15+ is guaranteed to be larger than the assigned value of rating level 14+. For more information about age ratings, see [Age ratings values and definitions](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/age-ratings-values-and-definitions).

Below is the complete list of age rating values used across all App Store regions.
- `1000`: All
- `621`: 21+
- `620`: 20+
- `619`: 19+
- `618`: 18+
- `600`: 17+
- `416`: 16+
- `415`: 15+
- `314`: 14+
- `313`: 13+
- `300`: 12+
- `211`: 11+
- `210`: 10+
- `200`: 9+
- `108`: 8+
- `107`: 7+
- `106`: 6+
- `105`: 5+
- `100`: 4+
- `3`: 3+
- `2`: 2+
- `1`: 1+
- `0`: None

This restriction will require supervision in a future release.

keys.title: Apps Exempted from Rating Restrictions
keys.content: If present, the system exempts apps with bundle IDs in the array from age-based rating restrictions. The system uses intersection combine rules to combine multiple payloads and any exceptions that parental control apps provide, including ScreenTime.

keys.title: Movies Ranking Number
keys.content:
The maximum level of movie content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- `1000`: All
- `500`: NC-17
- `400`: R
- `300`: PG-13
- `200`: PG
- `100`: G
- `0`: None

keys.title: Region Code
keys.content: The two-letter key that profile tools use to display the proper ratings for the given region. The client doesn't recognize or report this data.

keys.title: TV Shows Ranking Number
keys.content:
The maximum level of TV content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- `1000`: All
- `600`: TV-MA
- `500`: TV-14
- `400`: TV-PG
- `300`: TV-G
- `200`: TV-Y7
- `100`: TV-Y
- `0`: None

keys.title: requireManagedPasteboard
keys.content: If `true`, copy-and-paste functionality is limited by the `allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged` and `allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged` restrictions.

keys.title: Accept Cookies in Safari
keys.content:
Defines the conditions under which the device accepts cookies. The user-facing settings changed in iOS 11, although the possible values remain the same. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated. Allowed values:

- `0`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking and Block All Cookies, and the user canʼt disable either setting.
- `1` or `1.5`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, and the user canʼt disable it. Doesn't enable Block All Cookies, but the user can enable it.
- `2`: Enables Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, but doesn't enable Block All Cookies. The user can toggle either setting.

keys.title: Allow AutoFill in Safari
keys.content:
If `false`, the system disables Safari AutoFill for passwords, contact info, and credit cards, and also prevents using the Keychain for AutoFill. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

> Note:
> The system still allows third-party password managers, and apps can use AutoFill.

keys.title: Allow JavaScript
keys.content: If `false`, Safari doesn't execute JavaScript. This restriction will require supervision in a future release.

keys.title: Allow Pop-ups
keys.content: If `false`, Safari doesn't allow pop-up windows. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

keys.title: Enable Fraud Warning
keys.content: If `true`, the system enables Safari fraud warning.

keys.title: Whitelisted Apps
keys.content: Use `allowListedAppBundleIDs` instead.

payloads.title: SCEP
payloads.description: The payload that configures Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) settings.

keys.title: Payload Content
keys.content: A dictionary containing the SCEP information.

subkeys.title: URL
subkeys.content: The SCEP URL. See Over-the-Air Profile Delivery and Configuration for more information about SCEP.

subkeys.title: Name
subkeys.content: A string that's understood by the SCEP server; for example, a domain name like example.org. If a certificate authority has multiple CA certificates, this field can be used to distinguish which is required.

subkeys.title: Subject
subkeys.content:
The representation of an X.500 name as an array of OID and value.

For example, `/C=US/O=Apple Inc./CN=foo/1.2.5.3=bar` translates to `[ [ ["C", "US"] ], [ ["O", "Apple Inc."] ], …, [ [ "1.2.5.3", "bar" ] ] ]`.

OIDs can be represented as dotted numbers, with shortcuts for country (C), locality (L), state (ST), organization (O), organizational unit (OU), and common name (CN).

subkeys.title: Challenge
subkeys.content: A preshared secret.

subkeys.title: Key Size
subkeys.content: The key size, in bits.

subkeys.title: Key Type
subkeys.content: Always `RSA`.

subkeys.title: Key Usage
subkeys.content:
A bitmask indicating the use of the key. Possible values:

- `1`: Signing
- `4`: Encryption

Some certificate authorities, such as Windows CA, support only encryption or signing, but not both at the same time.

subkeys.title: Fingerprint
subkeys.content: The fingerprint of the Certificate Authority certificate.

subkeys.title: Retries
subkeys.content: The number of times the device should retry if the server sends a PENDING response.

subkeys.title: Retry Delay
subkeys.content: The number of seconds to wait between subsequent retries. The first retry is attempted without this delay.

subkeys.title: Subject Alt Name
subkeys.content: The SCEP payload can specify an optional `SubjectAltName` dictionary that provides values required by the CA for issuing a certificate. You can specify a single string or an array of strings for each key. The values you specify depend on the CA you're using, but might include DNS name, URL, or email values. For an example, see Sample Configuration Profile or Over-the-Air Profile Delivery and Configuration.

subkeys.title: RFC 822 Name
subkeys.content: The RFC 822 (email address) string.

subkeys.title: DNS Name
subkeys.content: The DNS name.

subkeys.title: URI
subkeys.content: The Uniform Resource Identifier.

subkeys.title: NT Principal Name
subkeys.content: The NT principal name. Use an other name OID set to `1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3`.

subkeys.title: KeyIsExtractable
subkeys.content: If `false`, the system disables exporting the private key from the keychain.

subkeys.title: Allow All Apps Access
subkeys.content: If `true`, all apps have access to the private key.

payloads.title: Screensaver

keys.title: askForPasswordDelay
keys.content: The number of seconds to delay before the password will be required to unlock or stop the screen saver (the grace period). A value of `2147483647` (for example, `0x7FFFFFFF`) disables this requirement. To use this option, you must set `askForPassword` to `true`. Available in macOS 10.13 and later.

subkeys.title: SHKAllowedShareServicesItem

payloads.title: Single Sign-On
payloads.description: The payload that configures single sign-on (SSO).

keys.title: Name
keys.content: The human-readable name for the account.

keys.title: Kerberos
keys.content: The Kerberos dictionary.

subkeys.title: PrincipalName
subkeys.content: The principal name. If not provided, the system prompts the user for one during profile installation. Required for MDM installation.

subkeys.title: PayloadCertificateUUID
subkeys.content: The `PayloadUUID` of an identity certificate payload that the system can use to renew the Kerberos credential without user interaction. Set the payload type to either `com.apple.security.pkcs12` or `com.apple.security.scep` in the certificate payload. The configuration file needs to contain both the SSO payload and the identity certificate payload.

subkeys.title: Realm
subkeys.content: The properly capitalized realm name.

subkeys.title: URLPrefixMatches
subkeys.content:
The list of URL prefixes to match in order to use this account for Kerberos authentication over HTTP. If this key is missing, the system makes the account eligible to match all `http://` and `https://` URLs.

Begin the URL matching patterns with either `http://` or `https://`. The system performs a simple string match, so the URL prefix `http://www.apple.com/` doesn't match `http://www.apple.com:80/`. However, if a matching pattern doesn't end in `/`, the system automatically append a `/` to it.

subkeys.title: URLPrefixMatchesItem
subkeys.content: A URL prefix.

subkeys.title: AppIdentifierMatches
subkeys.content:
The list of app identifiers that the system allows to use this login. If this field missing, the system matches all app identifiers with this login.

Don't set an empty array. The array needs to contain strings that match App Bundle IDs. These strings can be exact matches such as `com.mycompany.myapp`, or they may specify a prefix match on the Bundle ID by using the `*` wildcard character. The wildcard character needs to appear after a period (`.`), and may only appear once, at the end of the string, for example, `com.mycompany.*`. When you provide a wildcard, the system grants access to the account to any app with a Bundle ID that begins with the prefix.

subkeys.title: AppIdentifierMatchesItem
subkeys.content: An app identifier.

payloads.title: SmartCard
payloads.description: The payload that configures a smart card.

keys.title: UserPairing
keys.content: If `false`, users don't get the pairing dialog, although existing pairings still work.

keys.title: allowSmartCard
keys.content: If `false`, the system disables smart cards for logins, authorizations, and screen saver unlocking. It is still allowed for other functions, such as signing emails and accessing the web. A restart is required for a setting change to take effect.

keys.title: checkCertificateTrust
keys.content:
Configures the certificate trust check and has one of the following possible values:

- `0`: Turns off certificate trust check.
- `1`: Turns on certificate trust check. A standard validity check is performed but doesn't include additional revocation checks.
- `2`: Turns on certificate trust check. A soft revocation check is also performed. Until the certificate is explicitly rejected by CRL/OCSP, it's considered valid. This setting means that unavailable or unreachable CRL/OCSP allow this check to succeed.
- `3`: Turns on certificate trust check. A hard revocation check is also performed. Unless CRL/OCSP explicitly says "This certificate is OK," it's considered invalid. This option is the most secure.

keys.title: oneCardPerUser
keys.content: If `true`, a user can pair with only one smart card, although existing pairings are allowed if already set up.

keys.title: tokenRemovalAction
keys.content: If `1`, the system enables the screen saver when the smart card is removed. Available in macOS 10.13.4 and later.

keys.title: enforceSmartCard
keys.content: If `true`, a user can only log in or authenticate with a smart card. Available in macOS 10.13.2 and later.

payloads.title: System Extensions
payloads.description: The payload that configures system extensions.

keys.title: AllowUserOverrides
keys.content: If `false`, restricts users from approving additional system extensions that configuration profiles don't explicitly allow.

keys.title: AllowedTeamIdentifiers
keys.content:
An array of team identifiers that defines valid, signed system extensions that are allowable to load. Approved system extensions are those signed with any of the specified team identifiers.

To avoid requiring an administrator to authorize the operation, you can activate system extensions that this key specifies using `OSSystemExtensionActivationRequest API`.

It's an error for the same team identifier to appear in both this array and as a key in the `AllowedSystemExtensions` dictionary.

keys.title: AllowedSystemExtensionTypes
keys.content:
A dictionary that maps a team identifier to an array of strings, where each string is a type of system extension that you can install for that team identifier. The allowed extension types are `DriverExtension`, `NetworkExtension`, and `EndpointSecurityExtension`.

If there's no entry for a specified team identifier in the dictionary, the system allows all extension types.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: The mapping of team identifier to an array of strings, where each string is a type of system extension that may be installed for that team identifier.

subkeys.title: AllowedSystemExtensionTypesItems
subkeys.content: Permitted System Extension Type

keys.title: AllowedSystemExtensions
keys.content:
A dictionary of approved system extensions on the computer. The dictionary maps the team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier defines the system extension to install.

To avoid requiring an administrator to authorize the operation, you can activate system extensions that this key specifies using `OSSystemExtensionActivationRequest API`.

It's an error for the same team identifier to appear in both the `AllowedTeamIdentifiers` array and as a key in this dictionary.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: The mapping of team identifiers to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier is that of the system extension to be installed.

subkeys.title: AllowedSystemExtensionsItems
subkeys.content: Allowed system extension bundle ID

keys.title: RemovableSystemExtensions
keys.content:
A dictionary of system extensions that are allowed to remove themselves from the machine. The dictionary maps team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier defines the system extension. An application using the `OSSystemExtensionDeactivationRequest` API can deactivate the specified system extensions without requiring an administrator to authorize the operation.

Available in macOS 12 and later.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: The dictionary maps team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier defines the system extension.

subkeys.title: RemovableSystemExtensionsItems
subkeys.content: Removed system extension bundle ID

keys.title: NonRemovableSystemExtensions
keys.content: A dictionary of system extensions on the computer. The dictionary maps the team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier defines the system extension which can't be disabled or uninstalled when SIP is enabled. It's an error for the same mapping to appear in the dictionary values corresponding to `RemovableSystemExtensions` and `NonRemovableSystemExtensions` keys.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: System extension bundle identifiers

subkeys.title: NonRemovableSystemExtensionsItems
subkeys.content: Non Removable system extension bundle ID

keys.title: NonRemovableFromUISystemExtensions
keys.content: A dictionary of system extensions on the computer. The dictionary maps the team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers, where the bundle identifier defines the system extension which can't be disabled or uninstalled from System Settings or Finder. The set of system extensions between `RemovableSystemExtensions` and `NonRemovableFromUISystemExtensions` can to overlap.

subkeys.title: ANY
subkeys.content: System extension bundle identifiers

subkeys.title: NonRemovableFromUISystemExtensionsItems
subkeys.content: Non Removable from UI system extension bundle ID

keys.title: BackupAllVolumes

keys.title: BackupSkipSys

payloads.title: VPN
payloads.description: The payload that configures a VPN.

keys.title: Type
keys.content:
The type of the VPN, which defines which settings are appropriate for this VPN payload.

If the type is `VPN` or `TransparentProxy`, then the system requires a value for `VPNSubType`.

`TransparentProxy` is only available in macOS. `L2TP` and `IPSec` aren't available in tvOS. `AlwaysOn` is only available on iOS and Apple Watch pairing isn't supported with `AlwaysOn`. For a previously paired Apple Watch, all phone-watch communications cease when `AlwaysOn` is enabled. Not available in watchOS.

keys.title: VPN Subtype
keys.content:
An identifier for a vendor-specified configuration dictionary when the value for `VPNType` is `VPN`.

If `VPNType` is `VPN`, the system requires this field. If the configuration targets a VPN solution that uses a VPN plugin, then this field contains the bundle identifier of the plugin. Here are some examples:

- Cisco AnyConnect: `com.cisco.anyconnect.applevpn.plugin`
- Juniper SSL: `net.juniper.sslvpn`
- F5 SSL: `com.f5.F5-Edge-Client.vpnplugin`
- SonicWALL Mobile Connect: `com.sonicwall.SonicWALL-SSLVPN.vpnplugin`
- ``Aruba VIA: `com.arubanetworks.aruba-via.vpnplugin`

If the configuration targets a VPN solution that uses a network extension provider, then this field contains the bundle identifier of the app that contains the provider. Contact the VPN solution vendor for the value of the identifier.

If `VPNType` is `IKEv2`, then the `VPNSubType` field is optional and reserved for future use. If it's specified, it needs to contain an empty string.

Not available in watchOS.

keys.title: User Defined Name
keys.content: The description of the VPN connection that the system displays on the device. Not available in watchOS.

keys.title: Vendor Configuration Dictionary
keys.content: The vendor-specific configuration dictionary, which the system reads only when `VPNSubType` has a value. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Realm
subkeys.content: The Kerberos realm name, which needs to be properly capitalized. Valid only for Juniper SSL and Pulse Secure. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Role
subkeys.content: The role to select when connecting to the server. Valid only for Juniper SSL and Pulse Secure. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Group
subkeys.content: The group to connect to on the head end. Valid for Cisco AnyConnect and Cisco Legacy AnyConnect. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Login Group or Domain
subkeys.content: The login group or domain. Valid only for SonicWALL Mobile Connect. Not available in watchOS.

keys.title: VPN
keys.content: The dictionary to use when `VPNType` is `VPN`.

subkeys.title: Account Username
subkeys.content: The VPN account username.

subkeys.title: Account Password
subkeys.content: The VPN account password. Only use this if `AuthenticationMethod` is set to `Password`.

subkeys.title: RemoteAddress
subkeys.content: The IP address or hostname of the VPN server.

subkeys.title: Authentication Method
subkeys.content: The authentication method to use.

subkeys.title: Certificate UUID
subkeys.content: The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use for account credentials.

subkeys.title: Provider Bundle Identifier
subkeys.content: The bundle identifier for the VPN provider. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Provider Designated Requirement
subkeys.content: If the VPN provider is implemented as a system extension, this field is required. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Enable Disconnect on Idle
subkeys.content: If `1`, disconnects after an on-demand connection idles.

subkeys.title: Disconnect on Idle time
subkeys.content: The length of time to wait, in seconds, before disconnecting an on-demand connection. In watchOS, the maximum allowed value is `15`.

subkeys.title: ProviderType
subkeys.content: The type of VPN service. If the value is `app-proxy`, the service tunnels traffic at the app level. If the value is `packet-tunnel`, the service tunnels traffic at the IP layer. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Include All Networks
subkeys.content:
If `1``, routes all traffic through the VPN, with some exclusions. Several of the exclusions can be controlled with the `ExcludeLocalNetworks`, `ExcludeCellularServices`, `ExcludeAPNs` and `ExcludeDeviceCommunication` properties. The following traffic is always excluded from the tunnel:

- Traffic necessary for connecting and maintaining the device's network connection, such as DHCP.
- Traffic necessary for connecting to captive networks.
- Certain cellular services traffic that is not routable over the internet and is instead directly routed to the cellular network. See the ExcludeCellularServices property for more details.
- Network communication with a companion device such as a watchOS device.

Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Enforce Routes
subkeys.content:
If `1`, all the VPN's non-default routes take precedence over any locally defined routes.

If `IncludeAllNetworks` is `1`, the system ignores the value of `EnforceRoutes`.

Available in iOS 14.2 and later, and macOS 11 and later. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Exclude Local Networks
subkeys.content: If `1` and `IncludeAllNetworks` is `1`, routes all local network traffic outside the VPN. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Exclude Cellular Services
subkeys.content: If `1` and `IncludeAllNetworks` is `1`, then the system excludes internet-routable network traffic for cellular services (VoLTE, Wi-Fi Calling, IMS, MMS, Visual Voicemail, etc.) from the tunnel. Note that some cellular carriers route cellular services traffic directly to the carrier network, bypassing the internet. Such cellular services traffic is always excluded from the tunnel. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Exclude APNs
subkeys.content: If `1` and `IncludeAllNetworks` is `1`, then the system excludes the network traffic for the Apple Push Notification service (APNs) from the tunnel. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Exclude Device Communication
subkeys.content: If set to `1` and `IncludeAllNetworks` is set to `1`, the device excludes network traffic used for communicating with devices connected via USB or Wi-Fi from the tunnel.

subkeys.title: Enable VPN On Demand
subkeys.content: If `1`, enables VPN On Demand.

subkeys.title: Prevent users from toggling VPN On Demand
subkeys.content: If `1`, the Connect On Demand toggle in Settings is disabled for this configuration. Available in iOS 14 and later. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: On Demand Match Domains Always
subkeys.content:
A list of domain names. The system treats associated domain names as though they're associated with the `OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry` key. This behavior can be overridden by `OnDemandRules`.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of `EvaluateConnection` actions in the `OnDemandRules` dictionaries.

Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: On Demand Match Domains Never
subkeys.content:
A list of domain names. If the host name ends with one of these domain names, the system doesn't start the VPN automatically. The system uses this value to exclude a subdomain within an included domain.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of `EvaluateConnection` actions in the `OnDemandRules` dictionaries.

Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: On Demand Match Domains On Retry
subkeys.content:
A list of domain names. If the host name ends with one of these domain names and a DNS query for that domain name fails, the system starts the VPN automatically.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of `EvaluateConnection` actions in the `OnDemandRules` dictionaries.

Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: On Demand Rules
subkeys.content: An array of dictionaries defining On Demand Rules.

subkeys.title: On Demand Action
subkeys.content:
The action to take if this dictionary matches the current network. Possible values are:
- `Allow`: Deprecated. Allow VPN On Demand to connect if triggered.
- `Connect`: Unconditionally initiate a VPN connection on the next network attempt.
- `Disconnect`: Tear down the VPN connection and don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.
- `EvaluateConnection`: Evaluate the ActionParameters array for each connection attempt.
- `Ignore`: Leave any existing VPN connection up, but don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.
Only the `Disconnect` action is available on watchOS 10 and later.

subkeys.title: Action Parameters
subkeys.content: An array of dictionaries that provides rules similar to the `OnDemandRules` dictionary, but evaluated on each connection instead of when the network changes. This value is only for use with dictionaries in which the `Action` value is `EvaluateConnection`. The system evaluates these dictionaries in order and the first dictionary that matches determines the behavior. Not available in watchOS.

subkeys.title: Action Parameter
subkeys.content:
A dictionary that provides rules similar to the OnDemandRules dictionary, but evaluated on each connection instead of when the network changes. These dictionaries are evaluated in order, and the behavior is determined by the first dictionary that matches.
The keys allowed in each dictionary are described below. Note: This array is used only for dictionaries in which EvaluateConnection is the Action value.

subkeys.title: Domains
subkeys.content: The domains to apply this evaluation.

subkeys.title: Domain Action
subkeys.content:
Defines the VPN behavior for the specified domains. Allowed values are:
* 'ConnectIfNeeded': The specified domains should trigger a VPN connection attempt if domain name resolution fails, such as when the DNS server indicates that it can't resolve the domain, responds with a redirection to a different server, or fails to respond (timeout).
* 'NeverConnect': The specified domains should never trigger a VPN connection attempt.

subkeys.title: Required DNS Servers
subkeys.content:
An array of IP addresses of DNS servers to use for resolving the specified domains. These servers don't need to be part of the device's current network configuration. If these DNS servers aren't reachable, the system establishes a VPN connection. These DNS servers need to be either internal DNS servers or trusted external DNS servers.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

subkeys.title: Required URL String Probe
subkeys.content:
An HTTP or HTTPS (preferred) URL to probe, using a GET request. If the URL's hostname can't be resolved, if the server is unreachable, or if the server doesn't respond with a 200 HTTP status code, a VPN connection is established in response.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

subkeys.title: DNS Domain Match
subkeys.content:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.
The system supports a wildcard (`*`) prefix. For example, `*.example.com` matches against either `mydomain.example.com` or `yourdomain.example.com`.

subkeys.title: DNS Server Address Match
subkeys.content:
An array of IP addresses. This rule matches if any of the network's specified DNS servers match any entry in the array.
The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, `17.*` matches any DNS server in the `17.0.0.0/8` subnet.

subkeys.title: Interface Type Match
subkeys.content: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

subkeys.title: SSID Match
subkeys.content:
An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails.
Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

subkeys.title: URL String Probe
subkeys.content: A URL to probe. This rule matches when this URL is successfully fetched (returns a `200` HTTP status code) without redirection. Not available in watchOS.
